Fusion of dental cementum to alveolar bone prevents tooth eruption; occasional limb abnormalities do not meet the involvement threshold.
Malignant smooth muscle tumor arising in the stomach; smooth muscle origin does not imply locomotor muscle disease or an infectious cause.
Benign papilloma confined to a breast duct; breast has no axis.

Focal pancreatic beta-cell hyperfunction causes congenital hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia; lasting neurologic injury is not established in most patients of this subtype.
